items.title: Ernest "Punch" Miller Interview, 1957-multiple
items.q: Earl Humphrey had the band then, that George Washington was playing

ctx.x: Did you ever have any battles of music in the places like, say, the Bows Club or any of those?

Well, I won two Cups, one at the Espinade Hall down there, against Chris Kelly. What's that, the Italian Hall? The Italian Hall, yeah, that's what it was, the Italian Hall, and I won another at the St. Elizabeth, off a band called, well it was Earl Humphrey had the band then, that George Washington was playing, and it used to have two bands and everybody had a little dance at them times. Two bands, one this corner. Earl Humphrey had a band with George Washington?
Earl Humphrey had a band with who in it?

items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: Yeah, man, Earl Humphrey was a wizard.

ctx.x: Was Earl a good drum on them?

Yeah, man, Earl Humphrey was a wizard. I don't know how you gotta be on stage, maybe that lady, maybe not a half rich woman. That ain't no good news, see that? That's too slippery. Yeah, your tuning slider. If you pull it out, it lose more.
Well, who was the fastest trombone player?
